name: Chicken Kitezhgrad
desc: A breaded chicken dish. The chicken is pounded thin, wrapped around herb-infused butter, coated in breadcrumbs, and fried until golden and crisp. Beneath the crisp crust, the meat remains tender and juicy, while warm, melted butter slowly spills out when cut open.

value.text: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 30% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
